messages:
Priya Sharma: Quick heads-up — APAC distributor (BlueBridge) is pushing for a higher reseller margin on the 3-year commit. They're asking for 28% vs our standard 22%.
Ethan Cole: Do we have ARR/commit numbers from them? 28% is pretty steep.
Priya Sharma: They've committed to $1.2M ARR year1, $1.5M year2, $1.8M year3. Customer segment is fintech (regulated), so they want private deployment options too.
Olga Ivanova: Tagging @Marcus (deal-desk) — pricing exception request incoming. Need to know if we can flex with a tiered rebate or only increase margin on volume bands.
Marcus (deal-desk): Can we get the gross-to-net and channel uplift modeled? Also need co-sell credit and if we require MDF/marketing commitments.
Priya Sharma: They offered to do a joint case study and 2 regional events/year. Open to MDF. Also want a 60-day proof-of-concept (POC) with dedicated infra during trial.
Jamie Tran: Security review note: APAC regulator requires data residency; Private deployment will add infra cost. That should factor into margin.
Ethan Cole: If we do tiered: 0-500k -> 22%, 500-1.5M -> 25%, 1.5M+ -> 28% that might align with their growth plan. But legal needs to sign reseller T&Cs.
Marcus (deal-desk): I'm okay running a 3-tier band if Finance signs off on unit economics. Marcus -> FinanceBot, can you run a quick margin burn?
FinanceBot: Requested. Uploading a simple model:```
Band,Volume,Redwood Net,Reseller Margin
0-500k,$500,000, $390,000,22%
500-1.5M,$1,000,000, $750,000,25%
1.5M+,$1,800,000,$1,296,000,28%
Total Commit:$3.3M,Net:$2,436,000
```
Priya Sharma: That helps. Does the model include private infra surcharge?
FinanceBot: Not yet — add estimated $120k/year infra OPEX for private hosting in APAC. Adjusted net ~$2.196M.
Olga Ivanova: With infra added, blended margin drops ~2.5 pts. We should consider requiring a 12-month prepaid component for the first year to protect cash flow.
Ethan Cole: Could offer 28% only on growth above 1.5M and require 12-month prepay + MDF commitments. Also add automatic rollback clause if partner churns customers within 180 days.
Marcus (deal-desk): Sounds reasonable. I'll draft an approval memo for leadership with three options: (A) Standard 22% + MDF, (B) Tiered bands (25/28) with 12mo prepay, (C) One-time pilot discount + strict ROI milestones.
Jamie Tran: Legal note — include data residency SLA and SOC2 + enumerated support SLAs for POC infra.
Priya Sharma: Can you circulate the memo by EOD? I need to respond to the partner tomorrow.
Marcus (deal-desk): Will do. Circulating draft in ~3 hours. If leadership greenlights option B, we'll need a signed commit and PO before activating higher bands. :thumbsup:
Ethan Cole: Thanks all. Priya, keep me looped on partner exec alignment.
Priya Sharma: Will do. Thanks everyone.
